title: The Seven Angels with Seven Plagues

questions.question: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and amazing, seven angels with seven ____, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is finished.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:1 (ESV): "Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and amazing, seven angels with seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is finished."

questions.question: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of ____ mingled with fire—and also those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of ____ with harps of God in their hands.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:2 (ESV): "And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mingled with fire—and also those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass with harps of God in their hands."

questions.question: And they sing the song of ____, the servant of God, and the song of the ____, saying, "Great and amazing are your deeds, O Lord God the Almighty!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:3 (ESV): "And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, 'Great and amazing are your deeds, O Lord God the Almighty! Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations!'"

questions.question: "Just and true are your ways, O ____ of the nations!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:3 (ESV): "And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, 'Great and amazing are your deeds, O Lord God the Almighty! Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations!'"

questions.question: "Who will not fear, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are ____. All nations will come and worship you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:4 (ESV): "'Who will not fear, O Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship you, for your righteous acts have been revealed.'"

questions.question: After this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of ____ in heaven was opened,
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:5 (ESV): "After this I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of witness in heaven was opened,"

questions.question: and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright ____, with golden sashes around their chests.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:6 (ESV): "and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, with golden sashes around their chests."

questions.question: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden ____ full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever,
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:7 (ESV): "And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever,"

questions.question: What were the seven golden bowls full of?
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:7 (ESV): "And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God who lives forever and ever,"

questions.question: and the sanctuary was filled with ____ from the glory of God and from his power,
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:8 (ESV): "and the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished."

questions.question: and no one could enter the ____ until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:8 (ESV): "and the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished."

questions.question: Which is NOT a descriptor of the song sung by those beside the sea of glass?
options: Great and amazing are your deeds
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:3 (ESV) says they sang the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb. It does not mention the song of David.

questions.question: The seven angels came out of the sanctuary clothed in pure, bright linen, with golden ____ around their chests.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:6 (ESV): "and out of the sanctuary came the seven angels with the seven plagues, clothed in pure, bright linen, with golden sashes around their chests."

questions.question: The sea of glass mingled with fire is a place where those who conquered the ____ were standing.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:2 (ESV): "And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mingled with fire—and also those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass with harps of God in their hands."

questions.question: The seven angels had seven plagues, which are the last, because with them the ____ of God is finished.
questions.explanation: Revelation 15:1 (ESV): "Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and amazing, seven angels with seven plagues, which are the last, for with them the wrath of God is finished."
